messages:
omar: Quick sync  We need final microcopy for the three product pages + the tiny webinar banner for next Wed. Can we finish in this thread?

maria: I'm free for a short pass. Main asks: hero clarity, one-sentence differentiator, CTA mapping, and benchmark card copy.

kyle: I'll drop a compact hero pass: Hosted: 'Start with the hosted API  easy auth, instant keys.' Dedicated: 'Reserved capacity, predictable performance.' Private: 'Deploy in your VPC with enterprise controls.'

liz: Love the brevity. For Dedicated hero, add 'SLA-backed' maybe in the subhead not the hero.

omar: Good call. For the one-line differentiator how about: 'Same API. Choose the environment that meets your requirements.' Keep it customer-facing.

maria: Slight tweak: 'One API. Multiple deployment guarantees.' Short and product-y.

kyle: Subheads proposals: Hosted: 'Self-serve onboarding + free credits.' Dedicated: 'Capacity reservations, autoscaling, and SLAs.' Private: 'VPC, KMS, and audit-ready deployments.'

nora: CTA map: Hosted -> 'Create account (free credits)'. Dedicated -> 'Request capacity quote'. Private -> 'Talk to solutions'. We'll add a small 'See webinar' link on Dedicated and Private pages.

liz: Webinar banner text: 'Live demo: Serving LLMs at scale  register for benchmarks & compliance walkthroughs.' Keep as a 44-char max headline if possible.

omar: Benchmark card: avoid hero numbers. Card copy idea: 'Benchmarks (typical): p95 < 120ms on short convo patterns for our hosted stack. See full report.' Link to blog.

maria: On tone: reduce jargon for marketing readers (no KV cache talk). Use clear benefit-first language.

kyle: Agreed. For the feature bullets on each page we'll do 3 bullets max. Hosted bullets: 'fast onboarding', 'scaling without infra', 'pay-as-you-go'. Dedicated bullets: 'predictable throughput', 'SLA & reserved GPUs', 'burst capacity'. Private bullets: 'VPC & KMS', 'on-prem option', 'audit logs & enterprise support'.

liz: I'll craft the microcopy doc with the new bullets and hero/subheads and add the banner mock.

nora: HubSpot routing: Hosted signups -> Growth pipeline. Dedicated/Private demo requests -> AE + solutions tag: 'capacity' or 'compliance'. I'll create two forms: 'capacity-interest' and 'compliance-demo' and wire rules.

omar: Dev ask: put the hero copy as strings in the doc so dev can paste into CMS. Devs want final copy by EOD.

dev-bot: Reminder: CMS deploy window for Tuesday is locked at 10am PT. Any content after 5pm PT risks missing the slot.

maria: OK let's lock: final copy in the doc by 4:30pm PT. Nora, please confirm HubSpot forms by then.

nora: Will do. I'll also include the form IDs in the doc.

kyle: I'll post the doc snippet now with exact strings. Maria, quick tone review after lunch?

maria: Yes. I'll handle tone + CTA phrasing. Then we can close. :thumbsup:
